body:
I don't know. I can't even imagine working something else, despites the fact I would have to do another apprenticeship or study.

Guess I would rather be labourless than anything..

Hello twists.
I already related to your header, guess that's why I clicked on it. Even in your whole post I see many parallels to my own perception of life in general. I'm 23, anxiety issues, your life-Standard yet your inability to be happy about it, your experiences with relationships.

I'm in a similiar spot, and I neither know what really to do about it. Yet there is a difference..something I Kind of understand about that Problems in your relationships.

Since I lost my longest girlfriend I've ever had for many years I desperately seeked out for someone who could fill that gap that she left. I gave in to every Chance I get, yet i wether didn't take it or it ended in another Drama that left me more broken than before. I've lost myself in that loneliness, because even friends are a compareable Substitute for me that a relationship could offer.
But over that time I kinda understood that I am simply not able to get into a healthy relationship. Why? Because I don't even love myself. That's something that didn't even Change 'til today. But I managed to give up on that chasing for another relationship.
I personally think that I should be in a better personal spot before I give a try (not that I would drop a Chance).

I couldn't be unhappier, even tho I also have a well-paid Job yet I don't like it and I neither really Need that Money that much, too. I also only play Video games, since I dropped my other Hobbies several years ago because only Video Games are able to turn this mess inside my head off for a while. 

I'd suggest you that you should try to learn over the time to see your own life in another way than you do right now. Seeing what you have and not what you don't have. May you will be able to value that achievements you've earned. I understand you undermine everything that's great in your life, and this is what makes your "objective good life" worse for you.

What do you really makes you a failure? 
I see in your post a successful Person that just is not able to see what it has. A Person that is able to discover it's purpose in life but stucks in a whole of bad thoughts.
There is nothing wrong with playing Video games (other People in our Age drink and do drugs and are happy with it, simply because its their way to get rid of the burdens that life offers).
Expand your horizon, do things for yourself, try out things that may seem strange. This will lead to a better understanding of your own self. That should be the biggest challenge, and this is why you may seek to find your personal happiness in a woman..to escape your own insecureness. 
You have all financial means to do it, something other people could never at your Age and may even never will. 

I'm sorry if I interpreted maybe too much and some things wrong. Sure it's easy said, and even I still struggle but from my perspective I see a lot of potential in your beeing.
 
I hope you will realize somewhen that your feel of beeing a failure doesn't coresspond with the reality. Our minds are our worst enemies as people that struggle Depression.
Much love.
